title: The Last Memory: Episode 1 — The Man Death Forgot
logline: When paramedic Mara Vale hears a dying man's final memory and sees it belong to a living stranger, she must decide whether Elias Voss is a victim of an immortal curse or its next accomplice.
synopsis: Paramedic Mara Vale hears a dying passenger's final memory and sees it belong to Elias Voss, an immortal stranger present at the disaster. Elias reveals that a supernatural exchange keeps him alive by consuming pieces of his identity. When Mara discovers the force has begun stealing memories connected to her, she chooses to stand with him anyway, only to hear the entity speak through her dead mother's voice.
hook: A dying stranger grips Mara's wrist and whispers a memory that belongs to a man who has not yet died.
target_audience: English-speaking viewers who enjoy supernatural mystery, restrained romance, and identity conflict.
episode_goal: Mara learns the rules of Elias's curse and chooses to protect him, despite hearing a memory that could expose him as dangerous.

characters.name: Mara Vale
characters.description: A sharp, compassionate paramedic who hears the final memory of anyone dying in her hands.
characters.motivation: To save lives without being consumed by the memories she carries.

characters.name: Elias Voss
characters.description: An ageless, guarded man whose name and personal history are disappearing whenever he survives another supernatural exchange.
characters.motivation: To discover what is taking his identity before he becomes nobody.

characters.name: The Pale Listener
characters.description: A silent supernatural presence that trades survival for pieces of Elias's identity.
characters.motivation: To complete its exchange and erase Elias completely.

scenes.purpose: Introduce the curse through a life-or-death encounter and place Elias inside an impossible memory.
scenes.setting: A damaged underground subway platform during an emergency evacuation.
scenes.beat_summary: During a subway collapse, Mara hears a vivid memory from a dying passenger that shows Elias standing beside the passenger decades earlier.
scenes.emotional_shift: Mara moves from controlled urgency to startled recognition.
scenes.emotional_objective: Turn Mara's professional focus into immediate supernatural suspicion.
character_actions: Mara kneels beside the trapped passenger and presses two fingers to his neck.
The passenger clamps onto Mara's wrist as flickering images reflect in her eyes.
Elias appears through the dust, and Mara notices the same antique scar on his hand as in the memory.
scenes.turning_point: The passenger dies with Elias's name unfinished, while Elias recognizes the memory as one he lost.

scene_causality.goal: Keep the passenger alive long enough to learn who the memory belongs to.
scene_causality.conflict: Mara must save a trapped passenger while a final memory implicates a living stranger.
scene_causality.outcome: The passenger dies after naming Elias's threat, and Elias is identified as the man from the memory.

dialogues.intent: To deliver a final warning before losing consciousness.
dialogues.text: He took my name first... the man with the black river in his eyes.

dialogues.intent: To identify the stranger connected to the dying man's memory.
dialogues.text: You mean him? He is standing right there.

scenes.purpose: Establish that the exchange steals identity through meaningful memories and make Mara's involvement consequential.
scenes.setting: An abandoned station office lit by failing emergency bulbs.
scenes.beat_summary: Elias explains that an entity preserves his life by taking one personal memory at a time, and Mara discovers the exchange has started targeting memories attached to her.
scenes.emotional_shift: Mara changes from suspicion to frightened empathy, while Elias allows himself to be seen.
scenes.emotional_objective: Build wary intimacy through shared vulnerability and a clearly defined supernatural rule.
character_actions: Elias pulls Mara into an abandoned station office and locks the door as distant lights blink out.
He writes his name, then watches the final letter fade from the paper.
Mara touches his wrist and hears her own childhood bedroom inside his stolen memory.
scenes.turning_point: Mara recognizes her own childhood memory inside Elias, proving the curse has made her part of the exchange.

scene_causality.goal: Mara must decide whether to leave Elias before the curse reaches her.
scene_causality.conflict: Elias needs Mara's help, but contact with him exposes her memories to the same force.
scene_causality.outcome: Mara learns the entity has already touched her memories and refuses to abandon Elias.
scene_causality.causal_link: The passenger's final memory led Mara to Elias, whose fading identity reveals the exchange's rules.

dialogues.intent: To convince Mara that his survival is a continuing punishment, not a predatory choice.
dialogues.text: Every time death reaches me, something else answers first—and it takes a piece of who I am.

dialogues.intent: To confront the personal cost of helping him.
dialogues.text: That memory was mine, Elias. If it can take me through you, saving you may erase me too.

scenes.purpose: Show Mara's consequential decision and launch the larger identity conflict with an earned supernatural threat.
scenes.setting: The abandoned station office as the emergency power fails completely.
scenes.beat_summary: When the Pale Listener arrives through the station intercom, Mara deliberately gives Elias her paramedic ID and orders him to remember her voice instead of surrendering another memory.
scenes.emotional_shift: Fear becomes defiance as Mara knowingly accepts a share of Elias's curse.
scenes.emotional_objective: Convert growing tenderness into an active, dangerous commitment.
character_actions: The dead intercom crackles with Mara's own voice calling Elias by a name he cannot remember.
Mara tears off her identification badge and presses it into Elias's hand.
Elias steps between Mara and the speaker as every light in the office goes dark.
scenes.turning_point: The entity answers Mara's refusal by using her mother's voice, revealing that it has already reached a memory Elias never possessed.

scene_causality.goal: Mara must protect Elias without surrendering the memory that makes their alliance possible.
scene_causality.conflict: The entity offers Elias his lost identity if he lets it consume Mara's connection to him.
scene_causality.outcome: Mara rejects the bargain, but the entity takes her badge and begins speaking in her dead mother's voice.
scene_causality.causal_link: Because Mara's memory has entered Elias's curse, the Pale Listener can now bargain through her identity.

dialogues.intent: To tempt Elias with restored identity at Mara's expense.
dialogues.text: Give me the woman who remembers you, and I will return the man you were.

dialogues.intent: To make a costly choice and anchor Elias to her living memory.
dialogues.text: No. Take my badge, take my name if you must—but you do not get to choose what he forgets.

next_episode_question: Why does Mara now hear Elias's stolen memories inside the voices of the dying?
